title: Hoarding Master: A mobile game fully vivecoded
author: Pilou97
selftext:
Every card in our mobile game comes from a real photo. The AI writes the card, never the art.

A card collecting game on iPhone, with a browser version too. Point your phone at an object, the photo develops like at a photo lab, and it becomes a collectible card: name, text, stats, rarity. Objects fall into 1000 categories, 379 revealed.

The AI is deliberately narrow. GPT Luna reads the photo and writes the name, flavour text, stats, rarity. It is cheap: 700 photos cost us 0.5 euros. The photo stays the card art

The only generated pictures are the 1000 category icons, made locally on an RTX 4090 with ComfyUI and Qwen Image.

Consistency is the hard part: a plastic bag has to feel as worthy of a card as a banjo, and rarity should come from the object, not the light. Drift, the model reusing the same adjectives, is our open problem.

We build it in a dev VM: one Superset window and shared claude code subscription.

Free, no ads: [https://hoarding-master.com](https://hoarding-master.com)
